svg.aria-label: Left: warps that must execute the add at each of eight tree steps for a 256-thread block; interleaved addressing keeps all 8 warps busy for five steps, sequential addressing halves them every step. Right: worst shared memory bank conflict per step; strided interleaved indexing reaches 8-way conflicts, sequential addressing never conflicts
